title: Camping in the Mountains
paragraphs: Never having camped before, Yasir agreed to join two friends on a weekend trip to the mountains, secretly worried he would be completely useless when it came to setting up a tent.
The first attempt at pitching the tent took nearly an hour and resulted in a structure that collapsed twice before finally staying upright, much to the amusement of his more experienced friends.
That night, lying outside under a sky full of stars he rarely noticed in the city, Yasir felt a quiet appreciation for the simplicity of the experience despite the earlier struggles.
By the end of the trip, he had learned enough to set up the tent alone, and more importantly, he had discovered that stepping outside his comfort zone occasionally brought real, lasting satisfaction.
